verdicts.title: The characteristic polynomial of a random unitary matrix and Gaussian multiplicative chaos - The $L^2$-phase
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the characteristic polynomial of Haar distributed random unitary matrices. We show that after a suitable normalization, as one increases the size of the matrix, powers of the absolute value of the characteristic polynomial as well as powers of the exponential of its argument converge in law to a Gaussian multiplicative chaos measure for small enough real powers. This establishes a connection between random matrix theory and the theory of Gaussian multiplicative chaos.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns convergence in law of powers of the characteristic polynomial of random unitary matrices to Gaussian multiplicative chaos, which shares only the vocabulary 'characteristic polynomial' with the conjecture and does not address p-adic derivative rank or communication complexity rank variance.

verdicts.title: Strong approximation of Gaussian $β$-ensemble characteristic polynomials: the edge regime and the stochastic Airy function
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We investigate the characteristic polynomials of the Gaussian $β$-ensemble for general $β>0$ through its transfer matrix recurrence. verdicts.title: Integer matrices with a given characteristic polynomial and multiplicative dependence of matrices
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We consider the set $\mathcal{M}_n(\mathbb Z; H)$ of $n\times n$-matrices with integer elements of size at most $H$ and obtain a new upper bound on the number of matrices from $\mathcal{M}_n(\mathbb Z; H)$ with a given characteristic polynomial $f \in \mathbb Z[X]$, which is uniform with respect to $f$.
